shellCommands.command: node --input-type=module -e "const base='http://127.0.0.1:3000'; const home=await fetch(base+'/'); const homeText=await home.text(); if(!home.ok||!homeText.includes('Reading list')) throw new Error('home failed'); const created=await fetch(base+'/api/books',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({title:'Piranesi',author:'Susanna Clarke',notes:'House of tides.'})}); const createdBody=await created.json(); if(created.status!==201||createdBody.book.status!=='reading') throw new Error('create failed'); const id=createdBody.book.id; const page=await fetch(base+'/book/'+id); const pageText=await page.text(); if(!page.ok||!pageText.includes('detail-view')) throw new Error('share page failed'); const detail=await fetch(base+'/api/books/'+id); const detailBody=await detail.json(); if(detailBody.book.notes!=='House of tides.') throw new Error('detail mismatch'); const finished=await fetch(base+'/api/books/'+id+'/finish',{method:'POST'}); const finishedBody=await finished.json(); if(finishedBody.book.status!=='finished') throw new Error('finish failed'); const list=await fetch(base+'/api/books'); const listed=await list.json(); if(listed.books.length!==1||listed.books[0].status!=='finished') throw new Error('list failed'); const missing=await fetch(base+'/api/books/nope'); if(missing.status!==404) throw new Error('missing status'); console.log('ok');" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8')); if(!data.books[0]||data.books[0].title!=='Piranesi') process.exit(1); console.log('file ok');" && printf '%s\n' '{"books":[]}' > data/books.json
